CSCI 300 · Lab 2

Learn Linux Commands, Then Complete the Student Tasks

Learn to identify your current user and location, navigate folders, create and edit files, and inspect basic system information. Read each lesson, try the examples, then complete the clearly marked student tasks in your own Ubuntu Terminal.

6 illustrated lessons4 student tasks5 screenshot slotsInteractive command practiceDownloadable report

🎯 Learning outcomes

01 · Explore

Use basic Linux commands to identify the user, location, files, and system information.

02 · Navigate

Move between Linux directories and create folders and files using the Terminal.

03 · Work with files

Create, write, read, and edit simple text files using Linux commands.

Why are we learning this? Operating Systems is not only about theory. The Terminal lets us interact directly with files, folders, users and system information. Linux command-line skills are also useful in servers, cloud computing, virtual machines, containers, cybersecurity and software development.
